title: Operational Research
objectives:
Operations Research is a discipline that involves the development and application of advanced
analytical methods to aid complex decisions. This course will provide students with the skills to
be able to apply a variety of analytical methods to a diverse set of applications. By achieving these
objectives, students will be equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills to apply operational
research techniques in a wide range of practical situations. They will be prepared to analyze
complex systems, optimize decision-making processes, and contribute to organizational efficiency
and effectiveness in various domains, including business, engineering, healthcare, logistics, and
finance.
syllabus:
1. Introduction to Operational Research
2. Constraint Programming
3. Dynamic Programming
4. Unconstraint Non-Linear Programming
5. Integer Programming
6. Linear Programming
